ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a latitude-longitude grid map of the North Atlantic area. At the top, longitude labels of about 20°, 10°, 0°, and 10° can be seen, and on the right side, latitude labels 60° and 66°34′ can be seen. Point M is located toward the west in the figure, and point N is located southeast of M. The two points are roughly between 60° and 66°34′N, with an average latitude near about 63°N. Then reason: Estimating from the latitude-longitude grid, the longitude difference between points M and N is about 10°, and the latitude difference is about 2°. For each 1° difference in the latitude direction, it is about 111 km, so the north-south distance is about 2×111≈222 km. In the longitude direction, at about 63°N, each 1° difference is about 111×cos63°≈50 km, so the east-west distance is about 10×50≈500 km. The actual distance between the two points can be combined as a right triangle: √(500²+222²)≈547 km, about 550 km.

先描述图像：图中是北大西洋一带的经纬网地图，顶部可见经度标注约为20°、10°、0°、10°，右侧可见纬度标注60°和66°34′。M点位于图中偏西位置，N点位于M的东南方向，两点大致处在60°—66°34′N之间，平均纬度约在63°N附近。

再推理：从经纬网估读，M、N两点经度差约为10°，纬度差约为2°。纬度方向每差1°约为111 km，因此南北距离约为2×111≈222 km。经度方向在约63°N处每差1°约为111×cos63°≈50 km，因此东西距离约为10×50≈500 km。两点实地距离可按直角三角形合成：√(500²+222²)≈547 km，约为550 km。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the geographic distance rules: 1° latitude is about 111 km; 1° longitude at latitude φ is about 111·cosφ km.
